actionAdapters.entry: Unity Editor 自动化通道 business asset and BundleCollectorSetting editing
actionAdapters.when: 更新已确认的资源资产、Collector 成员或序列化引用
按已确认 ConfigMaster 定位当前项目已有的 Collector
加载非场景资源并在消费方生命周期结束时释放 Handle
资源是需要统一实例回收链的 Prefab

allow: confirmed business consumer source and lifecycle ownership
deny: handwritten Unity asset, Prefab or Scene YAML
direct BundleBuilder invocation or Package build output; route these to nova-project-build-bundles
unrelated Package output, cache cleanup, CDN deployment or Player build

requiredFor: ambiguous ownership, Package, address, ConfigMaster, Collector or resource lifetime
replace non-generated asset or change existing resource ownership
build target or output scope change
delete, cache cleanup, external write, credential use, Git commit or push
confirmation.rule: 确认资源所有权、唯一地址、消费方、生命周期和最小写入集；输入或范围改变后旧确认失效。

evidence: 资源所有权、Collector、Package 和地址证据
Handle 的持有与 Release 或场景 UnloadAsync 责任
如需构建，由 nova-project-build-bundles 独立返回的 BuildResult
当前 PlayMode 下的最小加载与释放证据
